actions.label: Status
actions.description: Show whether the Mac's KVM and its sitter are reachable and what they see.
actions.agent: Read the Mac's KVM and sitter state: whether the KVM is reached, what the video and keyboard show, and the sitter's state. Changes nothing.

report.label: Status
report.description: The status as one JSON object: name, kvm, sitter and sitter_via.

actions.label: Look
actions.description: Take one read-only look at the Mac's screen through the KVM.
actions.agent: Take one look at the Mac's screen through its KVM and report what the sitter sees. Changes nothing.

look.label: Look
look.description: The look as one JSON object: the screen's state and the sitter's reading.
